lookback_source.quote: Review the medical record and interview staff to determine whether wandering occurred during the 7-day look-back period.

lookback_notes: The manual repeatedly refers to a "7-day look-back period" for determining whether wandering occurred and its frequency. The document does not state on these pages how the 7 days are counted relative to the ARD.

coding_levels.label: Behavior not exhibited
coding_levels.definition: Wandering was not exhibited during the 7-day look-back period. Skip to Change in Behavior or Other Symptoms item (E1100).

source.quote: Code 0, behavior not exhibited: if wandering was not exhibited during the 7-day look-back period. Skip to Change in Behavior or Other Symptoms item (E1100).

coding_levels.label: Behavior of this type occurred 1-3 days
coding_levels.definition: The resident wandered on 1-3 days during the 7-day look-back period, regardless of the number of episodes that occurred on any one of those days. Proceed to answer Wandering—Impact item (E1000).

source.quote: Code 1, behavior of this type occurred 1-3 days: if the resident wandered on 1-3 days during the 7-day look-back period, regardless of the number of episodes that occurred on any one of those days. Proceed to answer Wandering—Impact item (E1000).

coding_levels.label: Behavior of this type occurred 4-6 days, but less than daily
coding_levels.definition: The resident wandered on 4-6 days during the 7-day look-back period, regardless of the number of episodes that occurred on any one of those days. Proceed to answer Wandering—Impact item (E1000).

source.quote: Code 2, behavior of this type occurred 4-6 days, but less than daily: if the resident wandered on 4-6 days during the 7-day look-back period, regardless of the number of episodes that occurred on any one of those days. Proceed to answer Wandering—Impact item (E1000).

coding_levels.label: Behavior of this type occurred daily
coding_levels.definition: The resident wandered daily during the 7-day look-back period, regardless of the number of episodes that occurred on any one of those days. Proceed to answer Wandering—Impact item (E1000).

source.quote: Code 3, behavior of this type occurred daily: if the resident wandered daily during the 7-day look-back period, regardless of the number of episodes that occurred on any one of those days. Proceed to answer Wandering—Impact item (E1000).

federal_coding_rules.rule: Wandering is defined as the act of moving (walking or locomotion in a wheelchair) from place to place with or without a specified course or known direction; it may or may not be aimless and may or may not be driven by confused thoughts or delusional ideas.

source.quote: Wandering is the act of moving (walking or locomotion in a wheelchair) from place to place with or without a specified course or known direction. Wandering may or may not be aimless.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If wandering occurred, determine the frequency of the wandering during the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: If wandering occurred, determine the frequency of the wandering during the 7-day look-back period.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Pacing (repetitive walking with a driven/pressured quality) within a constrained space is not included in wandering.

source.quote: Pacing (repetitive walking with a driven/pressured quality) within a constrained space is not included in wandering.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Wandering may be coded even if the resident is in a locked unit.

source.quote: Wandering may occur even if resident is in a locked unit.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Traveling via a planned course to another specific place (such as going to the dining room to eat a meal or to an activity) is not considered wandering.

source.quote: Traveling via a planned course to another specific place (such as going to the dining room to eat a meal or to an activity) is not considered wandering.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Resident intent should not be taken into account when coding items in Section E; the section focuses on the resident's actions, not the intent of their behavior.

source.quote: Resident intent should not be taken into account when coding for items in this section.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Wandering is excluded from item E0200C (other behavioral symptoms not directed toward others).

source.quote: Item E0200C does not include wandering.

federal_coding_rules.rule: When E0900 is coded 1, 2, or 3, item E1000 (Wandering—Impact) must be answered; when coded 0, skip to E1100.

source.quote: Answer this item only if E0900, Wandering—Presence & Frequency, was coded 1 (behavior of this type occurred 1-3 days), 2 (behavior of this type occurred 4-6 days, but less than daily), or 3 (behavior of this type occurred daily).

federal_coding_rules.rule: E0900 is reached from E0300 when E0300 is coded 0 (skip to E0800) — the item follows E0800 in the sequence; the item stem asks "Has the resident wandered?" with codes 0-3.

federal.criterion: Review the medical record and interview staff to determine whether wandering occurred during the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Review the medical record and interview staff to determine whether wandering occurred during the 7-day look-back period.

federal.notes: Stated as step 1 of Steps for Assessment.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied pages do not tie E0900 to any payment or case-mix classification.
